jobs_results.title: Fullstack Developer - Angular, Java, Node.js
jobs_results.description:
Somos Plexus Tech. Una compañía tecnológica especializada en servicios y productos IT, basados en la innovación y el desarrollo. Fundada en el talento y las capacidades de nuestra gente, más de 2.800 profesionales desarrollan tecnología con alma para que organismos públicos, compañías del IBEX 35, grandes retailers, operadores turísticos y entidades financieras crezcan con nosotros.

Si lo que buscas es trabajar con las tecnologías más punteras del mercado y seguir progresando profesionalmente, ¡este es tu proyecto!

Ampliamos nuestro equipo y estamos buscando Desarrolladores/as Fullstack Angular, Java y Node, con al menos 4 años de experiencia y nivel alto de inglés, para unirse con nosotros a un importante proyecto del sector bancario a nivel internacional.

✅ QUÉ NECESITAMOS?
• JavaScript.
• Librerías Javascript (JQuery, Angular).
• Tecnologías back-end como Node JS, Mongo DB, Java, npm packaging, RESTful APIs.
• BBDD SQL y NoSQL.
• Metodologías ágiles y TDD.
• CI/CD, Jenkins y... Nexus.
• Docker, Git, GitHub, Openshift y Arquitectura de microservicios.
• Excelentes habilidades escritas y orales en inglés.

👌 QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS?
• Contrato indefinido + 100% teletrabajo.
• Sistema de retribución flexible en seguro de salud, tickets restaurante, guardería y transporte.
• Plan de carrera y formación técnica a medida, para que sigas desarrollándote desde dentro de la compañía.
• Formación de idiomas.
• Club Benefits de Plexus Tech, que da acceso a ofertas exclusivas en viajes, hogar, salud, tecnología, moda y más categorías.
• Formar parte de un equipo dinámico, colaborativo, apasionado por sus clientes y con ganas de dar lo mejor de sí mismo.

Nos apasiona la tecnología, pero sobre todo nos encantan las personas que la hacen posible. Porque con motivación, ilusión y trabajo en equipo estamos haciendo cosas maravillosas

jobs_results.title: Node.js developer
jobs_results.description:
Our client, a leading multinational company in the leisure and entertainment sector, currently in the process of expansion, with several work centers throughout Spain, and more than 500 employees.

Within its expansion plan we are looking for a Node.js Developer, He/She will be part of a team of developers working on the digital international group platform.

Main Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

Rebuilding of the group’s websites.
Creation of new sites and/or sites for new jurisdictions (countries).
Development of interfaces for new gaming providers.
Updating existing interfaces or protocols.
Development and maintenance of backend processes.
Development and maintenance of new frontend functionalities.
Knowledge, Expertise and Qualifications:

+3 years of experience using NodeJS.
Desirable/valuable: knowledge and experience with Express JS and Hexagonal Architecture.
Javascript, JQuery
HTML5/CSS3.
Desirable knowledge of PHP with any MVC framework (i.e.: Laravel, Symfony... Codelgniter, etc.). as our current platform is built in PHP.
SQL
GIT
A technical level in English is a must.

Knowledge of:

Azure cloud (desirable)
Design for mobile/responsive
Basic Linux knowledge.
Personal Qualities:

Ability to prioritize a wide range of workloads.
Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Patient and professional demeanour, with a can-do attitude.
We offer:

Full-time from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. with flexible hours and telework of 100% after the onboarding period, and 2 or 3 days a month arranged in the offices.
Work center: Barcelona (center), living in Barcelona area or willing to relocate.
intensive summer hours
Salary: Competitive depending on experience and ability of the candidate

jobs_results.description:
ʙᴀᴄᴋᴇɴᴅ ᴅᴇᴠᴇʟᴏᴘᴇʀ @ ʙʟᴜᴇᴛʜʀᴏɴᴇ
Node.js, TypeScript

𝘛𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘳𝘰𝘭𝘦 𝘪𝘴 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘫𝘶𝘴𝘵 𝘢 𝘫𝘰𝘣; 𝘪𝘵'𝘴 𝘢 𝘤𝘢𝘭𝘭𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘵𝘩𝘰𝘴𝘦 𝘸𝘩𝘰 𝘥𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘥, 𝘪𝘯𝘴𝘱𝘪𝘳𝘦, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘵𝘳𝘢𝘯𝘴𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘥𝘪𝘨𝘪𝘵𝘢𝘭 𝘭𝘢𝘯𝘥𝘴𝘤𝘢𝘱𝘦. 𝘑𝘰𝘪𝘯 𝘶𝘴, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘭𝘦𝘵'𝘴 𝘤𝘩𝘢𝘳𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘤𝘰𝘶𝘳𝘴𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘢 𝘧𝘶𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘸𝘳𝘪𝘵𝘵𝘦𝘯 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘳𝘴 𝘰𝘧 𝘴𝘶𝘤𝘤𝘦𝘴𝘴.

🌍 ʀᴇᴍᴏᴛᴇ, ᴡᴏʀᴋ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ᴀɴʏᴡʜᴇʀᴇ 🌏

About BlueThrone

Embark on a transformative journey with BlueThrone, a pioneer in the mobile app domain. We specialize in turning promising B2C mobile apps into market leaders, boasting over 49.5 million organic downloads and 4.6 million monthly active users.

With a mission to propel iOS and Android applications to new heights, we've achieved a remarkable ARR ᴏʀɢᴀɴɪᴄᴀʟʟʏ in just 25 months, exemplifying sustainable growth and innovation. Our team, rich in tech entrepreneurship and mobile marketing expertise, thrives in an environment that values... agility, a growth mindset, flexibility, creativity, and tangible outcomes.

𝘈𝘵 𝘉𝘭𝘶𝘦𝘛𝘩𝘳𝘰𝘯𝘦, 𝘺𝘰𝘶𝘳 𝘤𝘢𝘳𝘦𝘦𝘳 𝘪𝘴 𝘮𝘰𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘯 𝘢 𝘫𝘰𝘣—𝘪𝘵'𝘴 𝘢 𝘫𝘰𝘶𝘳𝘯𝘦𝘺 𝘵𝘰𝘸𝘢𝘳𝘥𝘴 𝘦𝘹𝘤𝘦𝘭𝘭𝘦𝘯𝘤𝘦 𝘪𝘯 𝘢𝘯 𝘪𝘯𝘯𝘰𝘷𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘷𝘦 𝘤𝘶𝘭𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘦 𝘸𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘩𝘪𝘨𝘩 𝘱𝘦𝘳𝘧𝘰𝘳𝘮𝘢𝘯𝘤𝘦 𝘪𝘴 𝘢𝘴 𝘷𝘢𝘭𝘶𝘦𝘥 𝘢𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘯𝘰𝘷𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯

The Opportunity

Dive into a groundbreaking role at the forefront of the music insights revolution. Our platform, celebrated for its pioneering approach to music analytics, connects users to music on a deeper level, evidenced by over 12 million downloads. This isn't just about software; it's about creating a community united by music.

As a ʙᴀᴄᴋᴇɴᴅ ᴅᴇᴠᴇʟᴏᴘᴇʀ specializing in ɴᴏᴅᴇ.ᴊꜱ and ᴛʏᴘᴇᴅᴄʀɪᴘᴛ, you will engineer the backbone of our leading music analytics platform. This position involves more than writing code; it's about building a robust foundation that powers seamless user experiences and enables expansive growth in our market reach.

Your Mission
• Design and implement scalable backend systems that support complex data operations and user interactions.
• Performance Optimization: Utilize ɴᴏᴅᴇ.ᴊꜱ and ᴛʏᴘᴇᴅᴄʀɪᴘᴛ to enhance system efficiency and handle increasing loads with minimal latency.
• Work alongside frontend developers, designers, and product managers to create holistic solutions that align with business objectives.
• Address technical challenges with innovative solutions that not only improve functionality but also contribute to the strategic goals of the company.
• Navigate through fast-paced project landscapes, employing agile frameworks to deliver scalable and robust solutions efficiently.

Your Expedition Toolkit
• 5 years of ʙᴀᴄᴋᴇɴᴅ ᴅᴇᴠᴇʟᴏᴘᴇᴍᴇɴᴛ experience with a strong portfolio of projects demonstrate your skill in ɴᴏᴅᴇ.ᴊꜱ, ᴛʏᴘᴇᴅᴄʀɪᴘᴛ and high-load backend service Development.
• Strong knowledge of ɴɢɪɴx and ᴅᴇᴠᴏᴘꜱ for effective infrastructure management.
• Comprehensive knowledge of databases (ᴘᴏꜱᴛɢʀᴇꜱQʟ, ᴇʟᴀꜱᴛɪᴄꜱᴇᴀʀᴄʜ), messaging systems (ʀᴀʙʙɪᴛᴍQ), and caching mechanisms (ʀᴇᴅɪꜱ).
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ᴀɢɪʟᴇ environment where quick iterations and feedback are a norm, and utilizing tools like ᴊɪʀᴀ for project tracking.
• Qᴜᴀʟɪᴛʏ ᴀꜱꜱᴜʀᴀɴᴄᴇ Expertise with focus on enhancing refining testing processes, ensuring code quality, and upholding accessibility and standard methodologies.
• Some experience with ᴍᴏʙɪʟᴇ Development technologies like ꜰʟᴜᴛᴛᴇʀ and ᴋᴏᴛʟɪɴ is a strong advantage.
• Excellent verbal and written ᴄᴏᴍᴍᴜɴɪᴄᴀᴛɪᴏɴ ꜱᴋɪʟʟꜱ to effectively articulate technical challenges and solutions to stakeholders.
• Professional Proficiency in ᴇɴɢʟɪꜱʜ language. Knowledge of ʀᴜꜱꜱɪᴀɴ and ʜᴇʙʀᴇᴡ Languages is a nice to have.

Why Join BlueThrone?

Join us in a role that's more than a job - it's a chance to be part of a transformative mission, propelling mobile apps to unparalleled success. We offer not just a career but a lifestyle, blending professional growth with personal well-being.

🚀 Innovative Culture: Be part of a company that's redefining the mobile app market, backed by a business model that blends professional growth with personal well-being.

🏝 Work from Anywhere: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere, with flexible hours that suit your lifestyle.

💻 Impactful Work: Your role directly contributes to the company's growth and success in the fast-paced world of mobile app acquisitions.

🏆 Collaborative Environment: Join a team of talented professionals in a supportive atmosphere that fosters creativity and innovation.

🃏 Career Development: At BlueThrone, personal and professional growth isn't just a possibility – it's a priority.

🌍 Global Reach: Work with a diverse team of 50 exceptional talents spread across over 19 countries, expanding your professional network and cultural understanding.

Ready to embark on a journey with BlueThrone? Apply Now

jobs_results.title: Software Engineer (Java, .Net, NodeJS, React, Angular, Mobile, VUE)
jobs_results.description:
Desde Kapres Technology buscamos un desarrollador senior de Node.js altamente capacitado y motivado para trabajar con un cliente multinacional del sector de seguros.

Como desarrollador senior de Node.js, será responsable de liderar el desarrollo de servicios de software confiables y altamente escalables utilizando Node.js en la plataforma Azure Cloud. Además, garantizará el cumplimiento de los últimos estándares de calidad, administrará sistemas en entornos de producción, mejorará continuamente la observabilidad y los sistemas de monitoreo en Azure y propondrá modificaciones arquitectónicas cuando sea necesario.

Responsabilidades clave:
• Contribuir al desarrollo y diseño de servicios de software altamente escalables y confiables utilizando Node.js en la plataforma Azure Cloud.
• Garantizar un alto nivel de calidad del código y cobertura de pruebas.
• Desarrollar prácticas efectivas de DevOps y gestionar la infraestructura como código (IaC)
• Mejorar continuamente los sistemas de... observabilidad y monitoreo en Azure para garantizar la confiabilidad y disponibilidad de los servicios.
• Proponer modificaciones arquitectónicas cuando sea necesario para mejorar el rendimiento y la escalabilidad del sistema.
• Contribuir a los esfuerzos innovadores del equipo presentando nuevas ideas tecnológicas y viendo buenas soluciones cuando surjan.
• Fomentar un ambiente de equipo colaborativo y desarrollar una comunicación efectiva con los miembros del equipo.
• Contribuir a los valores de la empresa ofreciendo constantemente soluciones de alta calidad

Requisitos:
• Al menos cinco años de experiencia en Desarrollo Node.js, con fuerte énfasis en el diseño y gestión de sistemas en entornos de producción.
• Experiencia demostrable en contribuir activamente al desarrollo de servicios de software escalables y confiables en la plataforma Azure Cloud.
• Conocimiento de OAuth2 y OpenID
• Experiencia en el diseño de modelos de datos de alto rendimiento para bases de datos NoSQL.
• Fuerte experiencia en Infraestructura como Código (IaC), con conocimiento de las prácticas de DevOps
• Capacidad comprobada para gestionar y orientar a un equipo de desarrolladores y ofrecer soluciones de alta calidad.
• Familiaridad con Git para control de versiones y metodologías ágiles para desarrollo de software.
• Capacidad para proponer modificaciones arquitectónicas y ver buenas soluciones cuando surjan.
• Excelente comunicación y habilidades interpersonales
• Se valorará la experiencia en la integración de API de LLM u otros sistemas de IA relevantes.
• El conocimiento del estándar OpenAPI es una ventaja.
• La experiencia con Azure DevOps es una ventaja.

Se ofrece:
• 25 días de vacaciones
• Flexibilidad horaria

jobs_results.title: Senior node.js
jobs_results.description:
At intive we believe that emerging digital technologies make life easier. Therefore, with more than 3000 people on board we help forward-thinking enterprises to design and build smart applications, software solutions and turn ideas into digital reality all around the world. To achieve the best results, we are constantly challenging assumptions and establishing new approaches.

You are a good match if you have:

- Hands-on experience in various applications including micro-services using industry-leading frameworks and design patterns, as well as good knowledge of software development and systems architecture.
- Experience with JavaScript and Node.js technology stack ideally with Typescript.
- Experience with Docker and containers.
- Actively developed and designed REST APIs.
- Proven knowledge of AWS and/or other public cloud providers like Azure, Google.
- Practiced contemporary software development methodologies: Agile, Scrum, XP, etc. with strong focus on application security... performance & maintainability.

You get extra points for:

- Knowledge of Container orchestration and Distributed Systems.
- Knowledge of GraphQL.

What you will be doing:

- Back-end development.
- Working with other team members of different profiles (QA, Product Owner, Scrum Master, back-end and front-end developers) to deliver shippable parts in a steady pace project.

Why intive?

We cultivate an environment where innovative ideas and excellence have room to thrive - even with a remote workforce. Our culture of learning rewards curiosity and gives our team members opportunities to learn, grow, and own the evolution of their careers.

- Remote Work, Flexibility & Balance – We work 100% remotely.

- Career Path Planning – You can create a career path based on your goals. We provide training and support to help you along the way.

- Training & Mentorship – Learning and Development is a big part of our company culture. You will have access to internal courses and training, and a robust mentorship program.

- Chapters – You will join the community of intivers sharing the same professional profile. There is space for knowledge sharing with people with similar capabilities to yours and to access the latest technology trends.

- Culture & Connection – We cultivate connections within teams, across functions, and up and down the org chart. We make sure everyone is noticed and feels connected to our mission and each other
